motivation: Initial GPU timing shows long few-shot prefills dominate complete-review processing. Fixed system and train-only demonstrations recur across requests.
scope: Optional exact-prefix KV reuse for frozen few-shot stages only; no prediction-response cache and no inference-review cache

cache_contract.contents: Only system and fixed training demonstrations before the query-review content
cache_contract.request_gate: Exact token-prefix match after original segment-aware encoding; otherwise run uncached path
cache_contract.immutability: Each forward receives its own cache view or copy; cached tensors and lengths cannot be updated by another request
cache_contract.qlora: No cache reuse across base and adapted model states
cache_contract.accounting: Record cache construction cost, prefix-token hit counts, suffix work, fallback count and GPU memory; classify as warm serving optimization

cpu: no query review stored in cache
gates.gpu_initial: Same short/middle/long development inputs as primary correctness check; compare all aspect scores, selected sentiment scores and final labels
gates.gpu_expanded: Compare cache-off and cache-on on all 100 development inputs before using the optimization in main evaluation
gates.admission: No final-label changes on the development equivalence gate. Report every nonzero probability difference; if label changes occur, withhold this optimization from the equivalent primary service configuration and investigate rather than silently relaxing the gate.

selection: Select on development input shapes, exactness, measured latency and memory only; evaluation labels cannot be used for optimization selection
baseline: Retain cache-off measurements and independently label cache-off versus prefix-cache warm results
stop_rule: Stop this extension if compatibility or numerical discrepancies cannot be resolved with a small isolated implementation, or if no material practical gain is measured
